correctness.rationale: Exact spectral projectors give the full Laplacian spectrum and every matrix-entry orbit. Algebraic substitution gives positive offdiagonal rational formulas for all nonempty parts, all h>0. Positive scalar numerator yields positive definiteness and diagonal positivity, while row sums equal one. On P4 exact four orbit formulas and Descartes rule yield the unique finite boundary. Symbolic identities and 12,760 independent rational entries passed; finite experiments are not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: Full infinite-family exact positivity classification for every heterogeneous community-size partition and every timestep h>0. A fourth-order Padé method with restricted general positive-system behavior has strict all-step entrywise positivity on a natural network family, contrasted with an explicit finite-time failure on the undirected 4-path. Provides reusable exact kernels and a nonroutine boundary of positivity versus method order.
